info.description: Immutable snapshots of a page's blocks for version history / restore

tenantKey.description: Set by webx-studio's Visual Builder (see VisualBuilder.tsx's saveVersion/loadHistory) so a WordPress-hosted page's small, non-globally-unique numeric id (e.g. WP page id 42) can't return another tenant's version history on a documentRef collision — Strapi's own page/landing document ids are effectively unique already, but this field is filtered on for every read regardless of contentType so the same code path is safe for both.
